description: SaunaLife Model G2 Garden-Series Outdoor Home Sauna DIY Kit The SaunaLife Model G2 Garden-Series Outdoor Home Sauna DIY Kit System boasts exceptional quality at great value. Featuring sturdy 1.65”-thick spruce planks with interlocking V-joints, this sauna offers a durable structure built for long-term use. Its slanted roof, premium EPDM roofing, and full floor keep the elements out, ensuring ultimate comfort for bathers. Spacious and Comfortable The benches and backrests are made with carefully chosen, smooth Aspen wood. LED lighting, with no visible dots and adjustable brightness, offers subtle light and highlights the stunning wooden interior. The 8mm tempered glass door, complete with a high-quality handle and strong hinges, adds to the superior craftsmanship of this exceptional home sauna. A Wellness Sanctuary at Home This state-of-the-art outdoor sauna kit can enhance your everyday well-being routine and offer a lifetime of rejuvenation and serenity for the entire household. Embrace the Sauna Life! Versatile Heating Options The G2 model can accommodate a wood-fired sauna stove or a 6kW electric sauna heater. It also comes with a heater safety guard for added protection. Experience a lifetime of health benefits in the comfort of your own backyard with SaunaLife Model G2 Garden-Series Outdoor Home Sauna DIY Kit w/LED Light System. The G2 Black includes outdoor black paint for customer application after delivery. The paint is recommended to be reapplied annually as needed to maintain the finish. Applying the paint after delivery allows for a smooth, even finish and helps avoid scratches or nicks that can occur during LTL freight shipping.
